desc: Inspect the DiligentFX Bloom module at /home/enes/Projects/c/cpp-thirdparty/diligent/git/DiligentFX/PostProcess/Bloom (README.md, interface/Bloom.hpp, src/Bloom.cpp) plus PostProcess/Common shared helpers: extract the host API (ctor/PrepareResources/Execute/SRV getters), required inputs (HDR color buffer format, BloomAttribs: Intensity/Threshold/SoftThreshold/Radius), internal buffers/mip chain and feature flags, and note the exact exported symbols available in the prebuilt libDiligentFX.a (check via nm).
result: Host API = Bloom(device, CreateInfo{EnableAsyncCreation}) / PrepareResources(device, ctx, PostFXContext, FEATURE_FLAGS) / Execute(RenderAttributes{pColorBufferSRV (only input), pBloomAttribs, pPostFXContext}) -> READY|PENDING / GetBloomTextureSRV(). BloomAttribs = Intensity(0.15)/Threshold(1.0)/SoftTreshold(0.125)/Radius(0.75) + internal AlphaInterpolation (BloomStructures.fxh). Internal chain = downsampled/upsampled/output pyramids, all R11G11B10_FLOAT, sized from FrameDesc.Width/Height (FEATURE_FLAGS only has FEATURE_FLAG_NONE). Output = SourceColor + bloom (upsample shader uInstID==0: return SourceColor+ColorSum) -> pointer-swap, not a composite. nm on build-linux libDiligentFX.a exports Bloom::{ctor,dtor,PrepareResources,Execute,GetBloomTextureSRV,UpdateUI} + all private compute methods.
